eps_definition.note: Alpha Vantage reportedEPS is a vendor-reported figure. It is NOT SEC-validated GAAP diluted EPS. Any surprise built on it is VENDOR_DEFINED_REPORTED_EPS_SURPRISE, never a GAAP surprise.

point_in_time_provenance.note: No official Alpha Vantage guarantee was found that historical estimatedEPS is the contemporaneous consensus preserved as of the announcement. The documentation describes the fields but makes no point-in-time, as-of-announcement or non-restatement claim for them. The limitation is recorded, not resolved by assumption.
point_in_time_provenance.empirical_counter_evidence: Historical reportedEPS is demonstrably RESTATED rather than preserved as announced: for every ticker that later executed a 10-for-1 split (NVDA, AVGO, LRCX and KLAC) the provider's historical EPS is carried on the post-split share basis, giving provider/SEC ratios clustered near 0.10 against the as-announced SEC exhibit figures. Restatement of reportedEPS does not by itself prove estimatedEPS is also restated, but it removes any basis for assuming the series is point-in-time.
point_in_time_provenance.consequence: Any surprise built on this source is VENDOR_DEFINED_REPORTED_EPS_SURPRISE computed from possibly-restated inputs, and must not be described as a point-in-time consensus surprise.

retrieval_integrity.note: A throttle notice is a transport failure, not a data finding. If any ticker remains throttled after retries the run reports DATA_ACCESS_BLOCKED and its coverage counts are NOT a coverage finding.

sec_crosswalk.tie_breaker: smallest |reportedDate - filing_date|; a remaining tie is REFUSED as ambiguous, never guessed

crosswalk_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic only. The frozen g5 crosswalk gate stands exactly as computed; nothing here replaces, relaxes or re-scores it.
crosswalk_diagnostics.binding_constraint: the SEC index's own parse coverage, not the provider's record coverage

definition_signature.split_restated_like_note: provider/SEC EPS ratio in [0.085, 0.115], the signature of a retroactive 10-for-1 split restatement of historical EPS
definition_signature.sign_disagreement_note: provider and SEC disagree on the sign of EPS; the signature of an adjusted/non-GAAP figure against a GAAP loss
definition_signature.interpretation: Differences are NOT random error. They decompose into (a) retroactive split restatement of historical EPS for the tickers that later split, and (b) a GAAP-versus-adjusted definition difference among the remaining near-parity pairs, including outright sign disagreements. Provider EPS is therefore vendor-defined, not SEC-validated GAAP diluted EPS, and its historical values are not preserved as announced.
